'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Pierre Dubreuil LS Infiltration''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Pierre Dubreuil]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name SCOUNDRELS. Pierre Dubreuil / BRINGHIMB4ME, WORLDS 2014 TO, 2010 form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Infiltration / Unlikely Allies|VB8-L-infiltration-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' BRINGHIMB4ME
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
